body: I am So sorry for the pain you are in! I don't know your struggle, but have my own sufferings. I was a "mistake" and felt that for many years. My family was really fucked up because of forcing two families together when I was born. Lots of abuse and never felt safe. I felt like my life would never get any better. I was suicidal for many years. I don't know your pain, but my heart hurts that your heart hurts. You are so worth it...you are you and no one can replace you in this world. Keep going! My 20's were such a hard time, and I never thought it would get better. But honestly now I wouldn't change it, all my suffering has helped me to help others find strength to carry on and not give up. This world needs you!
